statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let _J := fun (h : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℂ) => intervalIntegral f (-h) h MeasureTheory.volume; let Jr := fun (h : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) => intervalIntegral f (-h) h MeasureTheory.volume; let V := fun (n : ℕ) (β : ℝ) => ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, E ((k:ℝ)*β); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (α : ℝ) => ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*α); let M := fun (n q : ℕ) (β : ℝ) => ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius q:ℤ):ℂ)/(Nat.totient q:ℂ)*V n β; let H := fun (n q : ℕ) => (105:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ)); let Q := Finset.Icc (1:ℕ) 105; let A := fun (q : ℕ) => (Finset.range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q); let B := fun (n : ℕ) => ∑ q ∈ Q, ((A q).card:ℝ) * Jr (H n q) (fun β => ‖M n q β‖^2); let C := fun (n : ℕ) => ∑ q ∈ Q, ∑ a ∈ A q, (_J (H n q) (fun β => (M n q β)^2*E (-(n:ℝ)*((a:ℝ)/q+β)))).re; let U := fun (n : ℕ) => ∑ q ∈ Q, ∑ a ∈ A q, Jr (H n q) (fun β => ‖S n ((a:ℝ)/q+β)-M n q β‖^2); ∀ n : ℕ, 0<n → (7/2:ℝ)*(n:ℝ)<C n → B n<6*(n:ℝ) → U n≤(n:ℝ)/10 → let actual := ∑ q ∈ Q, ∑ a ∈ A q, (_J (H n q) (fun β => (S n ((a:ℝ)/q+β))^2*E (-(n:ℝ)*((a:ℝ)/q+β)))).re; C n-2*Real.sqrt (U n*B n)-U n≤actual ∧ (37/20:ℝ)*(n:ℝ)<actual

brief.en: Expand S²−M² and apply Cauchy–Schwarz to the mixed term across the indexed arcs. The stronger estimate in FR-9013 implies the input U≤n/10.
